query: SELECT x.id FROM eval_executions x JOIN eval_experiments e ON e.id=x.experiment_id JOIN user_sessions s ON s.user_id=e.owner_id WHERE s.session_id=$1 AND e.owner_id=$2 AND e.status='running' AND x.id=$3 AND x.lease_owner=$4 AND x.fencing_token=$5 AND x.status='running' AND x.lease_expires_at>NOW()
